newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ex-MOF official says 105-125 yen vs dlr no problem.
newsitem.headline: Ex-MOF official says 105-125 yen vs dlr no problem.

text.p: Former vice finance minister Makoto Utsumi said on Tuesday that he did not think there would be any problems if the yen stayed between 105 and 125 yen to the dollar.
He added that he expected the yen to move in this range until the end of this year.
Utsumi told a news conference that an important question facing the United States was how much it was prepared to redistribute its strong growth to the rest of the world by means of a strong dollar.
The dollar was trading at around 122.10 yen at 0554 GMT.
